t: The Flomasta Sink Kit, with Appliance Inlet, is a gloss white 40mm sink waste solution designed for efficient drainage in kitchens and utility rooms. This extendable kit, suitable for 1.5" bowl sinks, features a vertical outlet and compression fittings for secure installation. Constructed from durable polypropylene, it offers abrasion and corrosion resistance, ensuring longevity. An integrated appliance inlet and tee allow for easy connection of washing machines or dishwashers. The kit includes a seal to effectively remove unpleasant odours, maintaining a fresh environment. Its demountable and reusable design simplifies maintenance and future adjustments.
